correctness.rationale: The repaired result has the same numerical table and isolates the known iteration criterion from the full-group claim. Truncated multiplication gives the two stated equations for commuting in U. For b≠0 solving for w,z gives class size q² in U; b,c are invariant there, then the torus orbits are exactly c/b². For b=0,c≠0 checking the change d→d−cv, u→u+dv+cv² yields the invariant u−d²/c and an orbit spanning every d. The degree-four and central degree-five rows follow respectively from the bijective cube map and fourth-power torus orbits. For nonidentity a, elimination in grade j uses 1−a^j and cannot change earlier coefficients. In a fixed representative the prime-to-three part is exactly the linear substitution, so conjugation between fixed representatives lies in the fixed subgroup; those subgroups are abelian here. This gives the q², q³ and q⁴ orbit factors and all residual stabilizers. The resulting sizes exhaust all multipliers and give 22 classes at q=3 and 70 at q=9. Triple composition gives the coefficient b²(b²−c) in degree five, and any nontrivial pure degree-five jet has order three. This yields the stated order-nine full-class count, with no order-nine multipliers outside U.
residual_risks: The fresh check covers only U over F_3. The frozen replay path is python verify.py in the source package, with exhaustive F_3 pair output but only 52 sampled representative checks at q=9. The field-uniform result follows from the proof, not the finite tests.
Orders are orders in the length-six quotient, not a classification of torsion in formal infinite series.

value.rationale: The full automorphism group at this natural finite cutoff is not characterized by a class number for its Nottingham kernel. Resolving every multiplier fiber gives the exact effect of fourth-root resonances on the table and on commuting probability, and locates the order-nine classes rather than just the individual jets. This is useful as a tractable small-characteristic baseline beyond known unipotent statistics and the classical iterate calculation.
residual_risks: The value judgment is for the complete finite spectrum, not for an isolated count from a previously known iteration criterion or a claim about higher jet groups.
